definitions.explanation: A person or group chasing after someone who is fleeing. Often used in historical, literary, or dramatic contexts involving fugitives or escapes.

examples.japanese: {追|お}っ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}って→迫る：03928_semaru⟧きた。
{追|お}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいて⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げ{込|こ}んだ→逃げ込む：26822_nigekomu⟧。
examples.english: He shook off the pursuers and fled into the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脱走|だっそう}→脱走：15529_dassou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}らえる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{向|む}けた。
examples.english: The domain immediately dispatched pursuers to capture the escaped samurai.

notes:
Refers to those who chase a fugitive or escapee. Common in historical fiction, period dramas, and action narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to send pursuers after)
- {追|お}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{向|む}ける (to dispatch pursuers)
- {追|お}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まく (to shake off pursuers)
- {追|お}っ{手|て}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to flee from pursuers)

The word has a dramatic, literary quality and appears frequently in ⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧ (period dramas) and historical novels.
